overview: A thorough collection of Terry A. Davis & TempleOS media. Timestamps are approximate and in UTC. New content will be uploaded as it becomes available. Find archive data at: https://archive.org/download/TerryADavis_TempleOS_Archive/ Direct Archive.org servers https://archive.org/download/TerryADavis_TempleOS_Archive/torrents 2018-09-03: magnet:?xt=urn:btih:a31b3989986e78dc7e86e5611cb472c3a21b9098&dn=Terry+A.+Davis+-+TempleOS+Archive 2018-12-26: magnet:?xt=urn:btih:30925b334a0cc4521c5e6a83b7ae7ec46fd296e2&dn=Terry+A.+Davis+-+TempleOS+Archive There may be some logically duplicate but not physically duplicate content. Duplicate content is usually it's the result of multiple, separate uploads by Terry. These are left in for completeness. Some content may be corrupt or damaged. These too are how they were uploaded. MD5 sums are provided for validation. Duplicates were detected and md5sums created by using scorch (http://github.com/trapexit/scorch). List of corrupted files created using `ffmpeg -v error -i "file:${FILENAME}" -map 0:1 -f null -` and checking the error code. Video files from Terry are in a [timestamp] - [name] format where the timestamp is UTC ISO8601 format. The name is ei
